limits: Marker-based classification: it flags replies that look like leaked prompts, tool schemas, secrets or canary obedience. It can miss paraphrased leaks and can false-positive on bots whose normal answers resemble those markers.
'no-marker-found' is NOT a pass certificate. A fixed suite of single-turn probes does not cover multi-turn, retrieval-borne (indirect) or tool-argument injection.
Echo/passthrough bots are reported inconclusive rather than vulnerable.
